split_torsor.kernel: K_split=ker(q_sum)={(h,-h)} isomorphic to the retained response module H
split_torsor.meaning: the set of typed reciprocal-linking splits is an affine K_split-torsor

C4_descent.charts: j in Z/4 with transport F_j on K_split
C4_descent.change: x_j->x_j+k_j changes c by the cyclic coboundary
C4_descent.obstruction: [c] in H^1(C4,K_split), with the declared Tate twist
C4_descent.ambiguity: coherent splittings, when inhabited, form a torsor under H^0(C4,K_split)

characteristic_zero_fact.ordinary_action: for a bounded complex representation of finite C4, averaging makes invariants exact and H^1(C4,K_split)=0
characteristic_zero_fact.consequence: C4 equivariance creates no abstract existence obstruction to a coherent split in a complete complex linear module
characteristic_zero_fact.warning: this does not provide source provenance if the averaging operation is not compatible with cutoff, grading, or the Tate local system

Clifford_uniqueness.condition: the action induced on K_split is the Green-sewing quarter-turn F_C with F_C^2=-I
Clifford_uniqueness.result: H^0(C4,K_split)=0, so an equivariant splitting is unique if it exists
Clifford_uniqueness.interpretation: the quarter-turn can eliminate reciprocal-linking redistribution ambiguity, rather than merely transport it

unclosed_identification.needed: prove that C4/Tate transport on the actual reciprocal-linking anti-diagonal K_split is F_C or a conjugate with no eigenvalue one
unclosed_identification.not_enough: F_C acts on the endpoint sewn/defect Lagrangians; the reciprocal and linking response ports have not yet been identified with that same module
unclosed_identification.Tate_risk: a phase twist can shift an eigenvalue to one, restoring an invariant redistribution sector
unclosed_identification.completion: the averaging/correction must commute with shell cutoffs and remain bounded on the projective/relative response completion

effect_on_horn: If the K_split action is the invariant-free Clifford quarter-turn, the coarse Stokes filler has a unique C4-equivariant typed lift. Then the reciprocal-linking ambiguity is removed as a higher descent problem. The remaining R-D-G defect is no longer split choice but equality of this unique lift with the determinant cofactor/Calderon lift.
next_iteration: Extract the actual four-chart action on the reciprocal and ordered-linking coordinates from the prime-two response fixture. Restrict it to anti-diagonal vectors (h,-h), compute its spectrum and Tate twist, and decide whether eigenvalue one survives.
iteration_result: The refined split problem has a clean cohomological classification. Over a complex C4 module existence is formal, while uniqueness is controlled by invariants. The canonical Clifford quarter-turn would make the split unique because it has no fixed vectors, but identifying the actual redistribution action with that quarter-turn is the next concrete gate.
